summary.value: A neural network composed of an encoder and decoder network; the encoder uses gappy satellite data and the decoder reconstructs the full data image along with an error estimate

source.evidence: The DINCAE network (Barth et al., 2020) is a neural network composed of an encoder and decoder network. The encoder uses the original gappy satellite data (with additional metadata as explained later) and the decoder uses the output of the encoder to reconstruct the full data image (along with an error estimate).

encoder.value: Five convolutional layers (with 16, 30, 58, 110 and 209 output filters) with a kernel size of 3×3 and a RELU activation function followed by a max pooling layer with a size of 2×2

source.evidence: The input is processed by the encoder which is composed of five convolutional layers (with 16, 30, 58, 110 and 209 output filters) with a kernel size of 3× 3 and a rectified linear unit (RELU) activation function followed by a max pooling layer with a size of 2 × 2.

decoder.value: Five upsampling layers (nearest-neighborhood interpolation or bilinear interpolation) followed by a convolutional layer with the equivalent number output filters from the encoder

source.evidence: The decoder is composed of five upsampling layers (nearest-neighborhood interpolation or bilinear interpolation) followed by a convolutional layer with the equivalent number output filters from the encoder
